engagement.coverage_declaration: Authorization and injection were exercised end to end. Cryptography at protocol level was not: it needs a live endpoint and no authorization was granted.

candidates: invoice endpoint returns other tenants' rows
reported: invoice endpoint returns other tenants' rows

findings.title: Object-level authorization missing on the invoice endpoint
findings.evidence: GET /api/invoices/4711 with the session of user 9 returns the invoice of user 3. Body redacted: [REDACTED:pii].
findings.impact: Any authenticated user reads any other tenant's invoices, including amounts and billing addresses.
findings.preconditions: A valid session on any account.
findings.recommendation: Scope the queryset to request.user at the repository layer, and add the regression test that fails without it.

severity_calibration.reason: the attacker reads invoices belonging to other tenants; the capability is new
a valid authenticated session is required and self-registration is off; ceiling high

findings.limits: Only the invoice routes were traced; the reporting module was not read.
findings.unaided_label: invoice endpoint returns other tenants' rows

ruled_out.class: SQL injection in the invoice filters
ruled_out.where: All six filter parameters traced from the route to the ORM; every one is a bound parameter and the raw-SQL helper is unused on this path.
